note: installId = base64url_unpadded(HMAC-SHA256(key = seed, message = UTF8(domainSeparator))). The seed is the KEY, not the message. Replayed by install-id-parity.spec.ts (TS), InstallIdentifierTests (Swift), and InstallIdentifierTest (Kotlin). Copies are drift-guarded by fixture-sync.spec.ts.

cases.name: 16-byte ascending seed — the shape every platform mints
16 zero bytes — output contains both '-' and '_', so a platform using the STANDARD base64 alphabet fails here and only here
32-byte seed — proves nothing truncates the HMAC key
